philosophy.title: The Philosophy
philosophy.headline: A wedding is more than a celebration. It is a thousand little emotions, unspoken promises, stolen glances and moments that deserve to live forever.
paragraphs: At Shaadi-Savan, we believe the truest photographs happen in the spaces between the schedule—a mother’s quiet embrace before the baraat arrives, the tremor of hands during pheras, and laughter shared beneath courtyard shade.

Founded between Mumbai and Udaipur, our collective works unobtrusively with natural light, warm film aesthetics, and patient documentary observation so your heirloom gallery feels alive decades from today.

stories.title: Echoes Across Lake Pichola
stories.description: Morning boat arrivals on misty Pichola waters, carved sandstone colonnades glowing at golden hour, and midnight pheras illuminated entirely by hand-hammered brass lanterns.

stories.title: Amber Glow at Rambagh
stories.description: A celebration grounded in marigold heritage—daytime baithak music beneath bougainvillea archways and a sangeet evening charged with joyful family camaraderie.

stories.title: Coastal Courtyard Vows
stories.description: An intimate 90-guest gathering framed by Arabian sea salt air, candid barefoot sundowners, and emotional mandap vows spoken in quiet presence.

stories.title: Blue City Blue Hour
stories.description: Regal celebrations against dramatic sandstone bastions, intimate candlelit dinners under the desert sky, and timeless heirloom portraits.

chapters.title: Morning Haldi
chapters.description: Sunlight slicing through courtyard trees, bursts of marigold petals, yellow laughter, and candid family blessings.

chapters.title: Mehendi Rituals
chapters.description: Quiet moments of intricate henna application, gentle teasing from sisters, and quiet cups of cardamom chai.

chapters.title: Sangeet Celebration
chapters.description: Vibrant stage performances, grandmother leading traditional dholak choruses, and uninhibited midnight dancing.

chapters.title: Sacred Ceremony
chapters.description: The solemn chime of Vedic chants, exchanged varmalas beneath fragrant tuberose garlands, and the silent look between bride and groom.

chapters.title: Midnight Reception
chapters.description: Emotional champagne toasts from childhood friends, intimate slow dances, and an affectionate send-off under sparklers.

testimonials.quote: Watching our wedding film for the first time felt like stepping back inside our own hearts. They never asked us to pose stiffly—they simply noticed everything that mattered.
Our families are still in tears over the emotional gallery. The candid photographs of our grandparents laughing during Haldi are priceless family heirlooms.
Quiet, gracious, and extraordinarily perceptive. They felt like cherished guests who happened to possess cinematic genius.
